tagline: Clear the session, keep the thread

features.title: Clear & Continue
features.detail: A Handoff pill above the prompt asks Clear & continue? with Yes and No, then summarizes the session through a hidden fork, runs /clear, and fills the handoff into the fresh prompt. You review it and press Enter.

features.title: Handoff skill
features.detail: The session-handoff skill holds the instructions: goal, decisions, state, files, open tasks and the next step, under a word cap.
